label: NovaForge ERP (dogfood)
description: The Phase 7 proving-ground app: GL, AR, inventory with weighted-average costing, period close — authored entirely as metadata (PHASE-7 §2). Zero handwritten application code; one budgeted script (§5).

roles.name: controller
roles.description: Financial control: reads everything, executes reports, owns period close

roles.name: accountingManager
roles.description: Approves journals and invoices (SoD: never the preparer)

roles.name: arClerk
roles.description: Books invoices, customers, and their journals (the preparer role)

roles.name: reporting
roles.description: Scheduled report delivery scope (explicitly permissioned, never admin)

validations.name: balanced
validations.message: Entry must balance: total debit must equal total credit

validations.name: oneSideOnly
validations.message: A line carries debit or credit, never both

validations.name: dueNotBeforeInvoice
validations.message: Due date cannot precede the invoice date

validations.name: positiveAmount
validations.message: A credit note carries a positive amount

validations.name: nonNegativeOutstanding
validations.message: A dunning letter mirrors a non-negative outstanding balance

validations.name: receiptPriced
validations.message: Posting a receipt requires its unit cost

script.source: (function () { if ($record.status !== 'POSTED') { return {}; } if ($record.movementType === 'ISSUE' && $record.unitCost == null) { var page = $data.query('Item', '{}'); var item = null; for (var i = 0; i < page.rows.length; i++) { if (page.rows[i].id === $record.item) { item = page.rows[i]; break; } } if (item == null || item.inventoryValue == null || item.qtyOnHand == null) { return {}; } var avg = item.inventoryValue / item.qtyOnHand; return { unitCost: avg, value: $record.qty * avg }; } if ($record.movementType === 'RECEIPT' && $record.unitCost != null && $record.value == null) { return { value: $record.qty * $record.unitCost }; } return {}; })()

gapLog.blocker: Auto-journal from an invoice: createRecord cannot bind lines to the entry it just created — the created record's id is not captured into flow scope, and ${…} template resolution is top-level only, so an inline lines array inside a createRecord template passes through unresolved (§5's createRecord journal lines from templates is not expressible)
gapLog.workaround: The ar clerk books the invoice's journal as its own JournalEntry with inline lines (suite templates interpolate deeply, so the harness/API path works); the invoice flow posts the invoice itself
gapLog.proposed: createRecord captures the created id into step scope (${step.id}) + nested template resolution for children arrays
gapLog.resolvedIn: versioned platform feature — next platform increment

gapLog.blocker: Cross-record arithmetic in flows: updateRecord templates interpolate (${field}) but cannot compute over multiple records — the receipt-side weighted-average re-costing of Item.unitCost ((qtyOld×costOld + qtyNew×costNew) / (qtyOld + qtyNew)) is inexpressible declaratively
gapLog.workaround: Roll-up maintained inventoryValue/qtyOnHand keep the running average derivable; the one budgeted script costs issues from those roll-ups (§5's canonical escape-hatch case)
gapLog.proposed: expression-valued template slots (or a computeField primitive evaluated over queried bindings)

gapLog.blocker: Rollup fields on amountOutstanding: posting should stamp amountOutstanding = total once, but defaults evaluate before children persist and the resume write only carries the state field
gapLog.workaround: The suite/clerk sets amountOutstanding at invoice create; settlement decrements it on the POSTED invoice (per §2's pin — the invoice is not frozen, only its journal entry is; the bankFeed suite pins the decrement)
gapLog.proposed: rollup-derived initial values, or a stampOnTransition hook context

gapLog.blocker: Decimal fidelity in scripts: GraalVM JS computes in float64; money through $data.query reads and script arithmetic is not BigDecimal-exact by construction (PLAN.md §1 non-negotiable)
gapLog.workaround: The costing script's arithmetic stays exactly representable in the dogfood corpus (÷ by whole quantities); assertions pin the decimal-exact roll-ups the engine computes, not script floats
gapLog.proposed: a $decimal BigDecimal binding in the sandbox surface
gapLog.resolvedIn: versioned platform feature — next platform increment

gapLog.blocker: $data.query cannot filter by id (system fields are not authored fields, so the query-DSL leaf rejects them) — the costing script lists Items and matches id in JS
gapLog.workaround: Script scans the first page (≤200 rows) and matches client-side
gapLog.proposed: allow id (and version) as filterable system fields in the DSL leaf

gapLog.blocker: Once-only hook triggers: the afterSave posting flow re-suspends on every save of a SUBMITTED record (a memo edit re-requests approval)
gapLog.workaround: Guards read the state field, and the journeys save SUBMITTED exactly once; rejection leaves the record SUBMITTED (a resubmit re-suspends — acceptable, but noisy)
gapLog.proposed: idempotency flag on requestApproval (suspend once per record+step)

gapLog.blocker: No builder/runtime UI (the Phase 2 remainder): the ERP is authored as JSON through the definition APIs; runtime users have no pages yet
gapLog.workaround: apps/erp/*.json + suites are the authored artifact; ErpAppArtifactTests gates them through the exact save/compile checks the builder would run
gapLog.proposed: the Phase 2 builder shell — already the tracked remainder
gapLog.resolvedIn: the Phase 2 shells landed after the dogfood (builder + runtime); the 2026-08-24 review closed Phase 4 §11's remaining surfaces

gapLog.blocker: Weighted-average unit cost as a report column: avg(unitCost) is not the weighted average; the true average is inventoryValue / qtyOnHand, an aggregate-of-aggregates the v1 report vocabulary cannot express
gapLog.workaround: inventoryValuation reports the value/qty totals; the average is derivable (and asserted in the suite by dividing the literals)

gapLog.blocker: Realized gain/loss on settlement requires an allocation flow over payments × invoices with FX revaluation at payment-date rates — expressible with today's primitives only as per-case scripts, blowing the script budget
gapLog.workaround: v1 scope pins book currency USD, document-currency conversion at the document rate (fxRate carried, GL posts in book currency); settlement gain/loss is logged, not automated (§2's pin: revaluation/unrealized is a logged gap, and realized joins it)
gapLog.proposed: an allocate primitive (payment → invoices/credit memos, FIFO or specific)

gapLog.blocker: FIFO costing deferred by §11 Q1 (resolved): weighted-average only; lot machinery half-present in StockLedger
gapLog.proposed: costingMethod flag on Item + lot allocation

gapLog.blocker: Full dunning automation deferred by §11 Q2 (resolved): letters + scheduler only
gapLog.workaround: nightlyAging scheduled delivery is the v1 dunning surface

gapLog.blocker: Reopen resolves only through its own approval flow (§4): transition guards and hook guards evaluate the record's current (post-merge) state — a status == 'OPEN' guard cannot distinguish the audited CLOSED → OPEN reopen from the initial create, so gating reopen with requestApproval would suspend every period creation (and SoD would block the creating controller from approving it)
gapLog.workaround: The reopen edge is a listed, audited machine transition an accountingManager/controller write drives — audited, but not approval-gated
gapLog.proposed: transition-scoped hooks (trigger: onTransition, carrying prior state) or prior-state bindings in guards

gapLog.blocker: The close-checklist suite leg: §9 item 3's close checklist completes only with all tasks resolved needs the suite to observe the event-started process's tasks, but event-starts ride the spine asynchronously and the harness has no await/poll step — a queryRecord Task right after the CLOSING update races
gapLog.workaround: The checklist's all-tasks-then-confirm shape is structural (the BPMN parallel join gates confirmClose) and pinned service-level by BpmnProcessTests; the authored suite covers the CLOSING write gate instead
gapLog.proposed: an awaitTasks/poll step op (bounded retries over the inbox query)

gapLog.blocker: P&L amount slicing by account type: report groupBy/filters bind direct fields of one entity — JournalLine cannot group by account.type (the report vocabulary has no lookup-path traversal), so revenue/expense nets over journal lines are not expressible as a report
gapLog.workaround: plSketch is the structural section sketch over Account (type sections + count + drill-through to lines); the trial balance remains the amount surface, and the reconciliation suite pins the nets
gapLog.proposed: lookup-path groupBy/filters in reports (join lowering), or a denormalize-on-write harvest stamping the target's classification

gapLog.blocker: AP bill document: the Invoice entity is AR-shaped (required customer lookup, AR machine, AR aging) — a vendor bill document with its own numbering and subledger view is not authored
gapLog.workaround: AP rides the GL — JournalEntry postings against AP control accounts with the Vendor subledger (the ap-vendor-subledger suite leg books one end to end)
gapLog.proposed: a versioned APBill app template, or a polymorphic party lookup if a second dogfood flow demands one document shape

gapLog.blocker: Idempotent scheduled pulls: flow-side createRecord has no upsert/idempotency mode (the inbound-webhook mapping's mode: upsert + keyFields has no flow-IR twin) and scheduled templates have no cursor bindings, so the bankFeedSync flow's since is a constant and a re-pull of an already-settled transaction rejects on Payment.number's unique index
gapLog.workaround: The provider's feed window bounds v1; a duplicate rejects audibly (the scheduled run records the failure — never a silent double-apply), and the inbound paymentsFeed webhook (mode: upsert, keyFields: [number]) stays the idempotent push path the bankFeed suite pins
gapLog.proposed: createRecord { mode: upsert, keyFields } mirroring the webhook mapping + cursor bindings in scheduled templates (e.g. ${fire.cursor})
